summary: Defines four new job description attributes for IPP that let clients monitor the progress of a print job. They are optional extensions to IPP/1.0 and IPP/1.1. It updates RFC 2910 and was replaced by RFC 8011.

eli5.summary: You like knowing how far along a print job is. This adds a few gauges to the printing protocol so programs can show you the progress.

questions: how to monitor ipp print job progress
what are ipp job progress attributes
